content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to allow users to enter custom variables during program operation? My setup uses an incremental encoder to measure the length of items, and these lengths will vary based on the item being inspected. I want operators, who are not familiar with programming, to be able to modify the target length directly within the program while it's running, without having to stop the process or edit the code. I considered addressing this using [product_name] Web Editor, but I'll get access to that software in a few days. I'd like confirmation if this is the right direction.
Certain parameters and variables can be adjusted via the web server interface (the web editor is used to create these interfaces) or through the [product_name] integrated display.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focuses on allowing runtime modification of key variables, such as measuring lengths with an encoder, without requiring programming expertise or halting operations. Solutions offered include adjustment through a web server or the built-in display, meeting the goal of making parameter changes accessible to non-programmers.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a solution for operators to input variable values, like length, during operation—without any need for programming experience or code updates.
